name: CRUD Management Page
description: Creates a Vue component for managing an entity with list, create, edit, and delete functionality.
author: SmartAbp Team

placeholders.name: entityName
placeholders.description: The name of the entity, usually in camelCase (e.g., 'product').

placeholders.name: entityStore
placeholders.description: The name of the Pinia store for this entity (e.g., 'useProductStore').

placeholders.name: apiService
placeholders.description: The variable name for the injected API service.

placeholders.name: permissionPrefix
placeholders.description: The permission prefix for CRUD operations (e.g., 'ProductManagement.Products').
